description: This file defines the BinaryComparison class used for comparison operations within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation module. It includes methods for comparing strings and numeric values with considerations for PHP version compatibility and case sensitivity.

classes.name: BinaryComparison
classes.description: Provides static methods for comparing two values with support for various comparison operators, case sensitivity, and numeric tolerances.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Performs comparison between two operands based on the specified operator, considering string case and compatibility modes.

methods.name: evaluateComparison
methods.description: Executes the actual comparison logic based on the operator and case sensitivity flag.

methods.name: equal
methods.description: Checks if two values are equal, with special handling for numeric values and nulls.

methods.name: greaterThanOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if one value is greater than or equal to another, considering numeric tolerance and string comparison modes.

methods.name: lessThanOrEqual
methods.description: Checks if one value is less than or equal to another, considering numeric tolerance and string comparison modes.

methods.name: greaterThan
methods.description: Checks if one value is strictly greater than another.

methods.name: lessThan
methods.description: Checks if one value is strictly less than another.

methods.name: notEqual
methods.description: Checks if two values are not equal.
